title: month_year accepts non-padded single-digit months, storing non-canonical YYYY-M and corrupting the lexicographic from<=to ordering check
detail: Only the year's string length is checked, never the month's: "2024-1" passes and is stored verbatim. The lexicographic from<=to guard then misfires on mixed padding — "2024-2" > "2024-10" rejects a valid Feb→Oct range, while "2024-10"→"2024-2" (a true reversal) is accepted.
recommended_fix: Require month_str length 2, or normalize with string.pad_left before storing, so draft values stay canonical YYYY-MM and the from<=to comparison only ever sees zero-padded months.

title: Resend double-submit: second remint matches 0 rows and redirects to the old token, which can never resolve — a live check renders the unknown-link 404
evidence:
// 0 rows: the state moved under the referee — re-render the truth.
    Ok(pog.Returned(_, [])) -> wisp.redirect(to: "/reference/" <> old_token)
// the remint guard that makes the second POST hit this branch:
UPDATE reference_call
SET form_token = $2::text,
    form_token_expires_at = now() + interval '10 days'
WHERE form_token = $1
  AND status = 'contact_initiated'
  AND taken_over_at IS NULL
  AND form_token_expires_at IS NOT NULL
  AND form_token_expires_at < now()
detail: The expired page is a single no-JS button, so a plain double-click fires two POSTs (both pass the 2s timing floor). The second remint affects 0 rows (token already swapped) and redirects to the old token, which the GET can never find — a live, resent check renders the branded 404 unknown-link page.
recommended_fix: On a 0-row remint, render view_resent (the send already happened; the fake-success doctrine already covers state-moved rows) instead of redirecting to the unresolvable old token.
